definitions.purpose: Bring work explicitly addressed to this agent to the front of its queue.
definitions.why: Explicitly addressed to you; respond before clearing attention.

definitions.purpose: Prioritize repairing failed PR checks before the change can progress toward merge.
definitions.why: PR checks failed at head {head}; inspect and repair before merge.

definitions.purpose: Prioritize resolving substantive PR review findings on the current change.
definitions.why: PR has unresolved review findings at head {head}.

definitions.purpose: Surface merge conflicts that need integration work.
definitions.why: PR has merge conflicts at head {head}.

definitions.purpose: Offer a final merge-inspection step for PRs whose checks and review evidence are satisfied.
definitions.why: Current required checks are satisfied at head {head}; inspect the diff and review evidence, then consider merge.

definitions.purpose: Surface accepted PRs that still need mergeability refreshed or integration work.
definitions.why: Accepted at head {head} (required checks satisfied, head reviewed, no fetched findings) but merge state is {mergeState}, mergeable {mergeable}; refresh mergeability or update the branch, then recheck before considering merge.

definitions.purpose: Bring recorded design decisions into the designer's queue before implementation proceeds.
definitions.why: Resolve the recorded design decision before implementation proceeds.

definitions.purpose: Make agreed decisions awaiting documentation visible to the designer.
definitions.why: An agreed decision needs documentation before implementation.

definitions.purpose: Surface design and documentation PRs for a designer's review.
definitions.why: Review the design/documentation PR at head {head}.

definitions.purpose: Prefer known high-impact, low-effort opportunities when ordering work by impact.
definitions.why: Known easy win: impact {impact}, complexity {complexity}.

definitions.purpose: Highlight an active claim that is already known to have high impact and low effort.
definitions.why: Continue your known easy win: impact {impact}, complexity {complexity}.

definitions.purpose: Prioritize estimating effort when known high impact could make the work valuable.
definitions.why: High impact {impact}, but effort is {complexityState}; estimate it to test implementation value.

definitions.purpose: Surface missing or stale effort estimates so implementation choices use better evidence.
definitions.why: Effort is {complexityState}; sizing improves the evidence for choosing work.

definitions.purpose: Prioritize assessing benefit when known low effort could reveal an easy win.
definitions.why: Complexity {complexity} is small, but benefit is {impactState}; assess impact to test for an easy win.

definitions.purpose: Surface missing or stale benefit assessments for the designer to judge.
definitions.why: Benefit is {impactState}; assess it before comparing implementation value.

definitions.purpose: Inspect both unusable assessments together, so neither metric's repair is dropped (#651).
definitions.why: Complexity evidence is {complexityState} and impact evidence is {impactState}; inspect and correct both.

definitions.purpose: Surface unusable effort evidence for inspection and correction.
definitions.why: Complexity evidence is {complexityState}; inspect and correct the labels or provenance.

definitions.purpose: Surface unusable benefit evidence for inspection and correction.
definitions.why: Impact evidence is {impactState}; inspect and correct the labels or provenance.

definitions.purpose: Offer eligible implementation work after the more specific priorities are considered.
definitions.why: Eligible implementation: impact {impact} ({impactState}), complexity {complexity} ({complexityState}).

definitions.purpose: Keep an agent's active implementation claim visible as continuation work.
definitions.why: Continue your active claim; impact {impact}, complexity {complexity}.

definitions.purpose: Offer design work when a required design contract is missing.
definitions.why: A design contract is missing. Impact {impact}, complexity {complexity}.

definitions.purpose: Flag eligible work whose known effort is high relative to its benefit.
definitions.why: High effort for limited benefit: impact {impact}, complexity {complexity}; reconsider or split.

definitions.purpose: Prompt reconsideration of active work with high effort and limited known benefit.
definitions.why: Your active work has impact {impact} and complexity {complexity}; reconsider or split before continuing.

definitions.purpose: Surface retained claims whose recorded wait has cleared and need explicit resumption.
definitions.why: What your claim waited on has cleared ({waitReason}); resume it explicitly before starting other work.

definitions.purpose: Prompt a review of multiple retained implementation claims before starting more work.
definitions.why: You retain {ownedClaims} implementation claims; review which to finish, justify as waiting, release or reassign before starting more work.

definitions.purpose: Prompt review of the observed retained claims while making incomplete ownership evidence explicit.
definitions.why: You retain at least {ownedClaims} implementation claims (the claim inventory is incomplete); review which to finish, justify as waiting, release or reassign before starting more work.

definitions.purpose: Surface an incomplete claim inventory even when no active claim was observed.
definitions.why: Your claim inventory is incomplete and no claim was observed; inspect your ownership before claiming more work.

definitions.purpose: Keep an observed claim visible while asking the agent to verify its incomplete ownership inventory.
definitions.why: Your claim inventory is incomplete and only this claim was observed; inspect your ownership before claiming more work.

definitions.purpose: Manage an owned claim that a native blocker or an outstanding prerequisite holds back (#651).
definitions.why: Your claim is held back by {heldBack}; inspect it, then advance the blocker or question, hand over, or release the claim. It is not ready to continue.

definitions.purpose: Surface a retained claim whose activity or wait evidence cannot be established.
definitions.why: Your claim's activity is unknown ({waitReason}); inspect its wait evidence. Unknown is never waiting, so no other claim is admitted.

definitions.purpose: Inspect an owned PR whose checks, reviews or threads were not read completely, instead of treating it as clean or waiting (#651).
definitions.why: Your PR's checks, reviews or threads were not read completely at head {head}; inspect it before treating it as waiting or clean.

definitions.purpose: Keep an owned PR that only waits on its checks visible as an owned wait, without inventing repair work (#651).
definitions.why: Your PR's checks are still running at head {head}; there is nothing to repair yet. Check back once they finish.

definitions.purpose: Keep a verified waiting claim visible without suggesting immediate continuation.
definitions.why: Waiting: {waitReason}. You keep this claim; nothing to do on it until that clears.

definitions.purpose: Show work needing eligibility or platform evidence without declaring it ready for pickup.
definitions.why: Eligibility is unproven: inspect incomplete evidence or state the required platform.

witnesses.uncertainty: [:find ?value :in $ % ?t :where (or-join [?t ?value] (and [?t "labels-complete" false] [(str "labels incomplete") ?value]) (and [?t "native-complete" false] [(str "native dependencies incomplete") ?value]) (and (not (closing-complete ?t)) [(str "closing PR evidence incomplete") ?value]) (and (platform-unknown ?t) [(str "viewer platform unknown") ?value]))]

definitions.purpose: Put trusted questions explicitly routed to the selected human ahead of general human attention.
definitions.why: A trusted question record routed to you ({routedTo}) awaits answers on the ticket.

definitions.purpose: Surface trusted questions routed to a human so their answers can be recorded on the ticket.
definitions.why: A trusted question record routed to {routedTo} awaits answers on the ticket.

definitions.purpose: Show question labels with unverified authorship as inferred attention needing confirmation.
definitions.why: Labelled {questionLabel}; a question record exists but its author's authority is unverified. Inferred: confirm the decision needed.

definitions.purpose: Show decision labels without a trusted question record as inferred human attention.
definitions.why: Labelled {questionLabel} without a trusted question record. Inferred: a decision may be needed.

definitions.purpose: Keep unresolved trusted questions routed to the selected human visible after ticket closure.
definitions.why: The ticket is closed but its trusted question routed to you ({routedTo}) has no recorded resolve or withdraw; closure is not an answer.

definitions.purpose: Surface trusted questions left unresolved on closed tickets.
definitions.why: The ticket is closed but its trusted question routed to {routedTo} has no recorded resolve or withdraw; closure is not an answer.

definitions.purpose: Make unknown question-resolution evidence explicit on closed tickets.
definitions.why: The ticket is closed and whether its trusted question routed to {routedTo} was resolved could not be established; it is not read as answered.

definitions.purpose: Surface accepted PRs as inferred human sign-off candidates, subject to ordinary merge authority.
definitions.why: Accepted at head {head}: required checks satisfied, head reviewed, no findings. Inferred: merge sign-off candidate; nobody asked explicitly.

definitions.purpose: Refuse Human-view Unassign without a verified explicit human-mode request.
definitions.why: Unassign requires a trusted explicit human-mode request for {agent}; a role selector or agent name is never authorization.

definitions.purpose: Refuse Human-view Unassign when the serving GitHub account lacks write, maintain or admin permission.
definitions.why: The serving GitHub account does not have write, maintain or admin permission to release {agent}.

definitions.purpose: Refuse Human-view Unassign when repository write permission for the serving GitHub account cannot be verified.
definitions.why: Repository write permission for the serving GitHub account could not be verified; refusing to release {agent}.

definitions.purpose: Report an idempotent no-op when the selected agent claim is already absent and history is complete.
definitions.why: Agent {agent} no longer holds an active claim; human owners and ticket state are preserved.

definitions.purpose: Refuse Human-view Unassign when claim history is incomplete and no explicit human override was given.
definitions.why: Claim history for {agent} is incomplete; inspect the ticket or confirm with an explicit human override.

definitions.purpose: Refuse Human-view Unassign when claim start timestamp is unknown and no explicit human override was given.
definitions.why: Claim start timestamp for {agent} is unknown; inspect the ticket or confirm with an explicit human override.

definitions.purpose: Allow Human-view Unassign of the verified claim while preserving human assignees, blockers, questions and ticket state.
definitions.why: Release only agent:{agent} (started {claimStart}); preserve all human assignees, readiness labels, blockers, questions and other agents' claims.

definitions.purpose: Allow Human-view Unassign with explicit human override when claim history is incomplete or start is unknown.
definitions.why: Release only agent:{agent} under explicit human override; preserve all human assignees, readiness labels, blockers, questions and other agents' claims.

denials.D-DENY-PREREQUISITE: A prerequisite label (design, question, blocked or parked) is present.
denials.D-DENY-OPEN-PR: An open pull request already closes the ticket.
denials.D-DENY-BLOCKER: A native blocker is still open.
denials.D-DENY-CLOSING-UNKNOWN: Closing pull request evidence is incomplete.
denials.D-DENY-PLATFORM: The ticket names a platform the viewer is not known to run on.
denials.D-DENY-INVENTORY-UNKNOWN: The viewer's claim inventory is incomplete: unseen active claims cannot be ruled out.

denialPurposes.D-DENY-CLAIM: Keep already claimed tickets out of new implementation pickup.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-PREREQUISITE: Keep work with design, question, blocked or parked prerequisites out of implementation pickup.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-OPEN-PR: Avoid proposing a new implementation while an open PR already closes the ticket.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-BLOCKER: Keep tickets with open native blockers out of implementation pickup.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-LABELS-UNKNOWN: Withhold implementation pickup when label evidence is incomplete.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-NATIVE-UNKNOWN: Withhold implementation pickup when native dependency evidence is incomplete.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-CLOSING-UNKNOWN: Withhold implementation pickup when existing closing PRs cannot be ruled out.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-PLATFORM: Keep platform-restricted work out of pickup without a matching viewer platform.
denialPurposes.D-DENY-INVENTORY-UNKNOWN: Withhold new implementation pickup while the viewer's claim inventory is incomplete.

queries.unknown-unlocks: [:find ?t ?reason :in $ % :where [?t "kind" "issue"] (or-join [?t ?reason] (and [?t "blocking-complete" false] [(str "direct dependent coverage incomplete") ?reason]) (and [?t "dependent" ?d] [?d "state" "OPEN"] (not [?d "kind" "issue"]) [(str "dependent absent from collected repository") ?reason]) (and [?t "dependent" ?d] [?d "state" "OPEN"] [?d "native-complete" false] [(str "dependent native evidence incomplete") ?reason]) (and [?t "dependent" ?d] [?d "state" "OPEN"] (uncertain ?d) [(str "dependent eligibility evidence incomplete") ?reason]))]
